# Runs

Use a Run when execution may outlive the current turn, needs declared Control, produces retained artifacts/evidence, fans out, or must remain inspectable.

## Launch

```text
spawn recipe=<skill>/<recipe> values={...} as=run:<id>
```

Use the owning capability Skill to choose the Recipe and capability-specific values. Retain the returned Run id. A spawn result reports `launch_kind: "spawn"`; it is never evidence of registered-tool invocation.

A rare Skill Recipe may declare `singleton: true`. Do not pass `as`: the runtime derives `run:<skill>` plus the canonical `<skill>/<recipe>` identity, allows at most one singleton Recipe per Skill, and returns the same compatible healthy active Run instead of launching a duplicate. Contradictory Recipe identity, startup values, Control, or ownership fails closed. Delegation inherits both singleton identities instead of retargeting them. Runtime tool failures after executor entry or async launcher handoff retain their original error/cause/details instead of guessed argument-repair guidance. A later missing-value failure can follow partial work; inspect the existing evidence rather than blindly replaying the invocation. Pre-dispatch argument guidance is not proof that no preparation effect occurred, and dispatch is not actuation or closure. Configured retry policies remain unchanged.

Compact spawn/async-tool receipts use flat Markdown-list fields: run, state, launch_kind and admitted optional facts; model/thinking policy source-value relationships may nest. The displayed Run key has no duplicated namespace. Multiline values preserve their Markdown content, and structured/verbose data remains unchanged. A compact attachment receipt explicitly says existing Run reused; that reports the backend's reuse fact, not another generation, readiness promise or scope proof. A terminal result is never reused; after its runner exits, restart keeps the logical Run id but creates a new fenced generation. Continuity still depends on actor-owned validated state, not the Run id alone.

## Observe

Normally wait for the completion batch: ready trees reach an active root coordinator at the next safe model-step boundary after the full tool batch, or wake an already-idle coordinator through a debounced follow-up. Inspect only when requested, when meaningful attention arrives, or when the Run is overdue or blocked:

```text
inspect target=run:<id> view=recipe
inspect target=run:<id> view=trace
inspect target=run:<id> view=control
```

Fresh root completions use YAML frontmatter (run, state, admitted kind), followed by raw left-edge Markdown. Prepend the packet-local index only when two or more results are shown. Exactly one shown result omits its index even with omitted results; preserve omission/inventory metadata, internal member/generation/correlation and every saved message. This rule does not apply to numbered streams. New source captures put all runtime metadata above that body, with no service/file footer. files.groups gives one literal root plus relative entry paths; files.read_first names zero-based group/entry indices for the first useful source, not an automatic read. role/purpose guidance is English; Actor Markdown and path/name bytes are unchanged. External paths use separate roots; unknown bases remain explicit rather than guessed from cwd or Run id. Known cut counts alone may follow the cut body; unknown-loss warnings and packet omission/inventory facts stay in the header. Retained captures preserve their old bytes and presentation. No external #N heading, result:/preview: wrapper, list nesting, whole-body fence, Batch caption, members wrapper or routine outer counter is added. Primary/final Actor response uses kind:primary; explicit error/failure diagnostic text uses kind:diagnostic, never a launch command. Untracked fallback has no kind and keeps unknown original completeness/privacy explicit outside YAML. Known cut loss is [N characters omitted] at the cut, with no extra ellipsis or body clipping counters/flags in metadata. Unknown upstream loss remains separately unknown and does not assert a known positive omission. Exact source/generation/parent/location references remain in complete model content, with whole references or explicit omission, captured inventory recovery and non-done omitted states. The compact TUI independently renders literal headers/markers and native Markdown bodies from validated content-bound blocks; only whole header reference/location rows and framing are hidden. Expansion and invalid/missing hints reveal original text. Hashes/layout/markers establish consistency/correlation only, never authentication, read/action permission, acceptance or native truth. Authored YAML/next/tool/batch/omission lookalikes stay body content. Fresh packets share48KiB UTF-8 including service data, equally between up to64candidate rows, with256captured members and no redistribution of unused shares or fixed16KiB/2KiB text cap. Full admitted text fitting its share without upstream uncertainty has no cut marker; otherwise use the scalar/CRLF-safe prefix and exact retained-source loss. Allocation/text is frozen at admission; rendering/recovery does not reread sources or reallocate. Unsupported Pi event/control output is withheld. Source basis stays in reference metadata; retained structured coverage facts are not exposed as YAML clipping fields. Pending/queued/presented older formats—including #N records and the first frontmatter draft—keep exact bytes, hints and budgets. Encoding names are storage replay data, not public product choices, source permissions or work authority. No standing full-map instruction or automatic research/read follows; use selective same-session investigation when needed.

Current completion index values restart within each packet; they are not session-wide historical references. Completion streams are adopted but not enabled, and no start-stream command is available yet. Do not infer an active stream or reset a counter from missing metadata or a pending target, and never relabel older saved packets. The kernel-only allocator now commits fixed scope/order/indices, the counter and first-packet target activation together, and an internal fresh-session bridge can use it after current manager/generation admission. The default runtime does not opt in; no public action exposes it. Event reason or a matching ID alone is insufficient. Old callbacks/wrappers cannot act after replacement; fresh wrappers must belong to the current original manager. Startup/reload/resume and ambiguous imports remain closed to stream capture/ACK, without changing saved packets or inferring a counter from history. Its whole-range exhaustion or admitted counter unavailability yields a frozen unknown index (quoted "?" in fresh YAML; #? in older saved layouts), never partial indices or an automatic fresh stream. Old packets retain their original scope while a pending switch waits; uncertainty does not permit reallocation. Stream state outlives packet cleanup/receipt rotation. Malformed/missing state remains refused, not a zero counter or proof of non-connection.

Fresh explicit agent Trace summary clips use prefix… [omitted: N chars] from normalized retained turn; upstream [omitted: unknown]. The prefix is at most160UTF-16 source units, shortened by one only to keep an original surrogate pair intact. N counts Unicode code points removed from the normalized already-redacted retained turn, not its earlier4000-unit/session loss or a complete Actor answer. Malformed retained text has only [omitted: unknown], not a repaired prefix or invented gap. This read-time projection leaves original detail/source/history and short valid summaries unchanged; authored marker-looking text does not become metadata or refreshed saved content.

Agent Trace ids are opaque recorded-entry references within the current Run's command/file/session namespace, not chronological numbers. Native keys retain the same entry across sibling-session growth and manifest reorder; changed admitted entry/session identifiers change the key, without certifying arbitrary file edits. Ambiguous/private/degraded metadata has only bounded record/read-local fallback, and missing-id or oversized source behavior is unchanged. Do not parse an id as a path, treat it as original privacy/immutability or use it to recreate live authority.

Trace is bounded retained observation, so read its completeness summary. Prove final outcomes with terminal status, result, declared artifacts, and execution evidence rather than assuming retained Trace is exhaustive.

## Attention Reference Bounds

Fresh source notify/followup and explicit steers use block-YAML metadata with opaque selected body text. Metadata-only output is bare; an actual body follows opening/closing `---` with no added outer indentation or compiler fence. Artifacts precede Run files as typed shown/omitted/total mappings with whole path sequences. Counts describe unshown declared unique paths, not characters, missing files, production or body permission. Consider only the first eight unique nonempty declarations per group before filtering malformed Unicode; do not repair a path or fill its slot from a later declaration. No target existence/body is inspected. Steers alone share16KiB UTF-8 across the complete serialized metadata, delimiters, body and minimum later-group coverage; raw malformed/oversize essentials refuse before reference reads; unfit essential text/coverage remains retryable pre-admission unavailability, never a partial checkpoint. Ordinary notify/followup keeps its existing independent field/slot limits without a new shared16KiB/48KiB cap or path shortening. Source/unit proof is not compiled/actual-default-entrypoint or loaded-host acceptance.

A legacy body keeps at most500UTF-16 source units with surrogate alignment and no whitespace/Markdown normalization. A clipped value ends with U+2026 outside its source literal when literal rendering is used and has [omitted: unknown]; malformed visible text is unavailable rather than repaired. A separate body-basis/upstream note means original completeness/privacy is unproven, not necessarily positive loss. Canonical Trace still has no body payload. Saved envelopes retain their exact content through pending/queued/presented recovery; an admitted event is reused before any new formatting, even if its current source would now be malformed. Neither restyle nor blindly replay work.

Ordinary notify/followup selects this AX layout only for new sink delivery. Notify stays visible status without waking a model; followup alone adds ordinary non-displayed pi-actors-run-trace context with the same content and original event details. Physical order, seen-id handling, startup priming, sink failure/effect semantics and wake policy are unchanged. Committed strings are never regenerated. There is no format-selection option or alternate new-message layout; saved envelope content remains exact without passing through these formatters. Fresh urgent diagnostics use AX event/attention/stage records. Admission reports remains retryable, not no effects or a new workload retry instruction. A failed send is request failed with delivery/presentation unconfirmed; it does not prove the model received nothing. Unknown/conflicting recovery retains phase queued with the observed evidence status/reason and does not force resend. Diagnostic values preserve raw inner Markdown/CRLF under240UTF-16 units, aligning an original pair; clipping uses boundary … and [omitted: unknown], while malformed visible text is unavailable without an invented gap/count. This is current UI presentation only. The journal last_error keeps its earlier whitespace normalization/trim and4096-unit message-only retention, not a full original Error/cause or authoritative count. This creates no new source, native authority or retry service.

## Investigate Known Files

Compact spawn/async-tool receipts now carry `file_navigation`: observed canonical starting locations for that exact generation, admitted against the current session before and after observation. It needs no catalog/body read or original producer key; missing/stale/foreign locations stay unavailable, and oversize rows are omitted whole within the compact card budget. Locations are mutable research data, not body/privacy/terminal/native proof. The compact run_files value keeps the whole selected observed location data in nested block YAML or reports a whole Run-row omission with shown/omitted/total counts, within the shared16KiB bound including response spacing. JSON-compatible details and saved terminal-packet encodings are unchanged. The optional current-session full-map command remains available but is not repeated when a complete direct location row is actually shown; absent/unavailable/omitted rows retain one next node naming tool=inspect, target=runtime, view=runs, verbose=true rather than disguising a command as observed data. It never executes automatically. New completion packets also capture bounded member location rows once, in root-first order with observed failed subtrees before peer children. They use only the remaining shared model budget after outcomes, with separate honest Run-row counts. Reload/render never reads sources or refreshes that data. Old absent/request-only packet formats keep their earlier text; source/npm SDK verifies an explicitly requested result read from a terminal row, without routine polling or original producer keys. Inherited locations/hints never transfer ownership.

For an explicit file investigation, request the existing management route:

```text
inspect target=runtime view=runs verbose=true
```

Its `navigation` selects only the actual current logical session's already cataloged, generation-checked directories. Start at the root's context index/result, then follow selected locations with ordinary file tools; no original producer key is needed. Resuming the same saved session after restart retains this research scope; a new/forked/cloned session does not inherit it through copied history or paths.

The ordinary map keeps independent roots latest-registration-first and puts known failed child subtrees before other siblings without moving a descendant ahead of its ancestors. For an explicit failed investigation use inspect target=runtime view=runs status=failed verbose=true. This filters inventory, not navigation: the full owned map then puts observed failed root subtrees first, with recency as the stable peer tie-break. Its priority.root_order is latest_registration or failed_subtrees_first and priority.basis=observed_failed_rows; missing/unmatched observations remain unranked, not proof of success. Ordering grants no ownership/terminal/native authority and does not read extra evidence or rewrite the catalog.

This bounded map marks file_inventory_scope=canonical_starting_locations and reports file locations, observed sizes and format_hint (json/jsonl/text). Hints describe the expected layout, not validated syntax/UTF-8 or complete output; it is not a full file inventory, body, original privacy, terminal/clock/native truth or authority to change state. Missing/nonregular/stale locations stay unavailable, whole-row omission counts are explicit, and corrupt/missing catalogs report `catalog_unavailable` without repair or turning healthy Runs into failures. New launches and explicit compatible singleton attachments register their exact existing generation; reads never scan/backfill missing entries. A `catalog: unavailable` launch warning means that separate registration attempt did not complete, not that the work failed. Do not relaunch merely to repair the map; even failed publication can leave committed catalog bytes. Current ordering covers directly owned rows and their exact same-session parent links, not a complete cross-session descendant tree. Compact/default inspection still does not build a map. Launch text offers that request as a fallback when no complete direct row is shown; existing new-outcome formats retain their optional request. Neither embeds a session-wide map or file bodies.

The published_sessions link, when physically present, locates the fixed session catalog under the owned Run root. No semantic index or original producer is required for this location or ordinary read. Presence is not certified catalog content/privacy/publication, and it does not enumerate raw session directories or automatically read nested previews. Missing/nonregular/symlinked locations have no usable path; never guess another location from that refusal.

For explicit recorded-capture research, read the mapped execution manifest, select the recorded command/attempt/stream reference and use ordinary file tools selectively. Keep the canonical capture layout under the mapped owned Run root; recorded strings are not permission to follow arbitrary declarations or leave that root. Distinguish reported saved/observed bytes and incomplete persistence from the current file size; reading a file does not certify complete primary output or original curated privacy. This is an explicit research choice, not an automatic fallback when an outcome's retained primary source is unavailable.

## Parent Shutdown

Existing parent-session teardown applies at trusted SDK quit/reload/new/resume/fork, including session replacement rather than only process exit. The current lifetime accepts fresh matching SDK context wrappers once; stale/replaced callbacks cannot act merely because a logical ID matches again. This uses existing exact-session-owner and Run-generation Kill guards, not delivery ancestry or a global PID scan. UI callback failure does not itself kill Runs or remove their parent shutdown binding.

Do not infer successful native closure from a teardown count, signal attempt or status. Abrupt Pi death, hung shutdown and bare AgentSession.dispose without the trusted event remain outside this repair. Logical-session ownership also does not isolate parallel Pi hosts reopening the same ID; no host-instance ownership or new native supervisor is introduced. Do not repeat destructive work from a missing report or assume stream/timing authority from shutdown binding.

## Control

Send an actor-local action only when the root Recipe declares and implements it:

```text
message target=run:<id> action=<declared-action> input={...}
```

Inspect Control when readiness, capacity, stale work, or saturation matters. Put large data in an artifact and send only a bounded reference or instruction. Use runtime-owned termination for a stuck Run rather than inventing undeclared service actions.

Read a compact Control receipt as a flat Markdown-list record, not a raw state dump: run/action identify the request; result, delivery and handling keep their stage meanings. Queued/delivered leaves handling unconfirmed rather than guessing the current journal state. The displayed run name omits its redundant run: prefix; actual next-action targets retain canonical run:<id> syntax. Multiline Markdown values are indented without injecting record nodes into their content. At most one next node describes an inspect tool/target/view; an unrecognized advisory is kept as instruction text, not guessed tool arguments or automatic execution. A kill attempt leaves full termination unconfirmed, regardless of legacy stopped/killed flags; Trace can record the attempt but cannot prove full-scope closure. Use the one contextual next action only when deeper evidence is needed; changed ownership/generation requires fresh owned inventory, never a blind retry. Request verbose JSON on the original action when full detail is needed, not by repeating a destructive action. An error after actuation can retain partial effects. Even delivery_failed can coexist with a recorded handled Control; use its existing admitted correlation and owned Control inspection when available, not automatic replay. Kernel exceptions retain the original transport value and later failed-status-recording errors, including separate FIFO write/close faults, without erasing partial effects. Their cause/errors chains are private diagnostic evidence, not a newly exposed tool schema or handling/closure receipt. Public actor-local dispatch exceptions remain failures, with a compact conservative message: delivery and handling unconfirmed, effects may already exist, do not repeat automatically. Use its fresh-owned-inventory hint only when investigation is needed, then select currently owned evidence; it is not routine polling. Saved ids/generation and raw causes are withheld even in verbose because admission-time scope does not prove reply-time scope. A long request target is wholly omitted with a separate run_omission reason/shown/omitted/total record under 16 KiB, never cut into a misleading reference. Public errors remain failures and use the same flat AX record with a multiline warning and an owned-inventory next action; saved ids/generation/raw causes are still not exposed. Missing admission correlation is never guessed. The awaited sendRunControl facade now retains its surfaced admission/delivery rejection plus a later lifecycle-release fault as ordered private AggregateError errors/cause, without flattening or coercing the original. A sole request/release error remains exact, including undefined, and handled/delivered facts are not rolled back. The existing await/lock interval is unchanged: no kill-independence, exhaustive release/native closure, current reply-scope or lower-layer already-masked cause is recovered. A missing Trace or correlation does not prove no action occurred, and archive/prune failure can follow a move/removal. Verbosity never grants ownership of replacement/foreign state: changed-owner/generation refusals omit that replacement status in public details/JSON as well as compact text, retaining the refusal and its safe inventory follow-up.

Manual archive/prune keeps its existing terminal/owner/generation/scope checks. Errors can follow an archive move, preserved artifact copy or completed directory removal. Kernel preserves a single surfaced rejection exactly, including primitive/undefined/original AggregateError; if later failure-text formatting, failed-record persistence or lock release also fails, ordered private cause/errors retain the original plus those later failures. Journal append/release has its own nested boundary; original aggregates are not flattened. A committed queued row may fail release before operation admission, while handled bytes/effects may exist before a later recording/release error. These are separate facts, not rollback, an atomic receipt or permission to repeat retirement. Inspect only available owned evidence selectively; no Run-local Trace after prune, missing correlation or exhaustive cleanup/native closure is promised. Automatic age cleanup remains its existing best-effort policy, not a new public error archive. Underlying synchronous locked mutations also retain exact callback/release failures in a private ordered aggregate without coercion/flattening or re-execution; callback-written bytes may already exist. A normal return, sole callback failure or sole release failure stays unchanged. This is neither asynchronous lock semantics nor successful-release/native proof, a new public receipt or recovery of an already-masked lower error. Atomic JSON/text replacement also keeps its exact surfaced rejection; a later retry-code accessor fault is retained privately after the original rather than replacing it. Existing bounded platform replacement retries remain unchanged and rerun neither preparation callbacks nor the containing operation. Replacement errors may follow committed bytes; no rollback, exhaustive cleanup or power-loss guarantee follows.

Control is not actor chat, peer routing, or a task inbox. A Recipe import does not create a peer actor. Several actors/subagents require the `swarm` methodology in addition to these Run mechanics.

## Tracked Completion Excerpts

Fresh completion bodies place [N characters omitted] directly at a known display cut, outside YAML and without an extra ellipsis. N counts Unicode code points of already-admitted postprivacy text: the exported primary source, retained Actor response or named diagnostic field, not complete native stderr or discarded private output. Original source totals/ranges remain in structured retained bindings; they are not metadata flags claiming full output. Upstream/legacy completeness/privacy may remain explicitly unknown even when the retained text fits. Source references stay exact; whole unfit references are explicitly omitted, never clipped. Saved packets preserve their original text/count grammar, including old direct omitted:N chars fields. Do not infer missing original lengths, widen source retention or treat an ellipsis as completeness; capture/layout identifiers are not tool arguments or read/work authority.

For an explicitly requested agent Trace view, clipped summaries show `[N characters omitted from retained turn; upstream count unknown]`. N counts only local display loss from the existing privacy-projected, whitespace-normalized retained turn; it is not a complete answer/session length. The source preview remains at most 160 UTF-16 units, aligned to full Unicode scalars. Malformed retained text reports `[omitted count unknown: malformed retained text]` instead; details/sources are not repaired. Short valid summaries and all previously saved completion/steer messages remain unchanged. This adds no automatic polling, retained body source or original-private-projection guarantee.

## Safety

Operate only on owned Runs and their active generation. Never edit Run state to force an outcome, bypass process identity checks, or signal processes directly from UI/instruction code. Restart creates new generation-local evidence; inspect the exact generation before destructive lifecycle action.
